name: Pleiku coffee
summary: Coffee from Vietnam’s fourth-largest growing province, drunk in Pleiku’s long-running cafes, with roasted beans sold to carry home.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s culinary journey calls Pleiku coffee a national reputation from one of Vietnam’s leading coffee regions. VnExpress International calls Gia Lai the country’s fourth-largest coffee-producing province and ties the cup to Pleiku’s soil and climate.
howToEat: Drink it in a Pleiku cafe.
Roasted beans are also sold to carry home.
seoDescription: Drink Pleiku coffee in the town’s long-running cafes. Gia Lai is Vietnam’s fourth-largest coffee province, and roasted beans are sold to carry home.
